name: Australian Military Bank

assessmentBufferPct.sourceTitle: Australian Military Bank Broker Guide — Home Loans, effective 15 June 2026 (Expenses, p13-15)
assessmentBufferPct.note: Guide states for variable-rate mortgage commitments: 'Calculate repayments based on a 3% increase over the current variable rate', and under 'Expenses are to include': 'A buffer on the interest rate applying to existing &/or new mortgage loans.' For fixed loans reverting to variable within the loan term a 3% buffer over the reverting variable rate applies.

assessmentFloorRatePct.note: No assessment-rate floor is published in the Broker Guide (effective 15 June 2026); the guide only describes the +3% buffer and refers to 'the Bank's approved loan Servicing Calculator'.

rentShadingPct.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Income table, 'Investment Properties rentals', p9
rentShadingPct.note: Income table scales 'Investment Properties rentals' at 80%. Where multiple rental sources are held the lowest is used for servicing. NRAS rental income is discounted to 65% for LMI submissions.

existingCommitmentTreatment.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Expenses (Fixed expenses table), p13-14
existingCommitmentTreatment.note: Personal loans and other loans/advances: 'Use current contracted repayment amount'. Mortgages are the exception — buffered at +3%. Credit cards and BNPL are benchmarked (see bnplTreatment).

bnplTreatment.value: Buy now, pay later (e.g. Zip Pay, Zip Money, Afterpay) is treated the same as a credit card facility: a monthly repayment calculated on the total credit limits over a 36-month term at the agreed card rate.
bnplTreatment.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Expenses (Fixed expenses table), p14

hecsTreatment.value: Calculated within the current HELP repayment threshold and rates, as declared by the member or evidenced from payslips; balance per the HELP statement obtained via myGov.
hecsTreatment.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Expenses (Fixed expenses table), p14

hemBasis.note: 'the Bank will apply the higher of: The members declared living expenses ... or The applicable figure from the Household Expenditure Measure (HEM), and Lender or system assessed actual expenses.'

dtiCap.note: Broker Guide (15 June 2026) describes DTI as 'incorporated into the Bank's auto decisioning methodology and delegated underwriting approval limits' and 'calculated using the Servicing Calculator', but publishes no numeric cap.

interestOnlyAssessment.value: Interest-only facilities have repayments calculated over the total loan term less the initial interest-only period (e.g. 30-year term with a 5-year IO term is assessed P&I over 25 years).
interestOnlyAssessment.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Acceptable Loan Purposes & LVRs, Interest Only loans, p18-19

notes.value: Unsecured overdrafts assessed at 3% of the limit per month; secured overdrafts at 1% of the limit per month. Joint applicants: 100% of jointly-and-severally-liable fixed commitments. Shared/apportioned expenses are a policy exception, consumer loans only. Pre-tax deductions are deducted from gross income; post-tax deductions are recorded as an ongoing expense.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Acceptable Loan Purposes & LVRs, p17-20
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: 'Max LVR for Owner Occupied is 98% inclusive of LMI'. LVR is inclusive of any capitalised LMI premium and/or stamp duty. For loans above 90% LVR the repayment type can only be P&I.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Acceptable Loan Purposes & LVRs, p17-20
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: 'Max LVR for Investment is 95% inclusive of LMI'.

maxLvrCashOutPct.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Equity Release (cash out) / Additional Security Information, p18, 24-25
maxLvrCashOutPct.note: 'Max LVR for debt consolidation and equity release is 90% LVR plus LMI'. Sub-limits: up to 70% LVR — max cash out 20% of security value; 70.01-80% — 20% of value and referred to an AMB assessor; 80.01-90% — subject to LMI requirements; above 90% LVR — no cash-out component allowed. Any cash out over $100,000 must be approved by AMB.

maxLvrConstructionPct.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Home Improvement / renovations / construction, p17
maxLvrConstructionPct.note: Owner occupied 98% inclusive of LMI; investment 95% inclusive of LMI. Construction must be by a licensed builder under a fixed price contract, maximum 2 dwellings. Interest only during the construction period is capped at 24 months.

maxLvrRefinancePct.note: Owner occupied 98% inclusive of LMI; investment 95% inclusive of LMI; where combined with equity release, controlled funds or debt consolidation, 90% inclusive of LMI. Satisfactory repayment history over the previous six months must be verified.

lmiCapitalisable.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Acceptable Loan Purposes & LVRs, p20
lmiCapitalisable.note: 'LVR includes capitalised LMI premium and/or stamp duty costs.'

lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Acceptable Loan Purposes & LVRs, p20
lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.note: Maximum LVRs are quoted 'inclusive of LMI'.

rules.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Employment (p6), Income (p7-12), Unacceptable Income (p13)
rules.note: Scaling percentages read directly from the guide's 'Acceptable Income / Scaling' table. Additional unacceptable income: housekeeping, workers compensation / WorkCover, any allowance not in the income table and not received for at least 12 months, and any stated-acceptable income that is not verified.

selfEmployedMinYears.note: 'We require at least 2 years financial years trading in the current business.'

oneYearFinancialsAccepted.note: Exception only: 12 months trading in the current business plus 2 years in previous employment in a similar occupation/field may be considered, based on the overall strength of the proposal.

notes.value: Self-employed borrowers are only considered where the business is affiliated with the ADF/DOD, the borrower is the spouse of an ADF/DOD employee who is also a party to the loan, or the borrower is ex-Defence. This is a hard filter, not a preference.

minMonthsCurrentJob.note: Permanent salary/wage (full time or part time) and contract employment: 'Minimum 6 months with current employer.'

probationAccepted.note: Exception basis only — 'at the discretion of the assessor'.

probationConditions.value: Where the borrower is within a 6-month probation period the application may be considered based on merits and the strength of the borrower's overall position; such cases are a policy exception at the discretion of the assessor. The relevant AMB assessor may approve shorter periods including probation.

minMonthsCasual.note: 'Casual and/or second job — Minimum 6 months with current employer. This does not apply to temporary employment.'

minMonthsContract.note: Contract employment sits in the same row as permanent salary/wage — minimum 6 months with the current employer. Where the loan term is outside the contract period, mitigating notes are required on the suitability assessment.

minMonthsSelfEmployedAbn.note: At least 2 financial years trading in the current business; 12 months plus 2 years prior similar employment may be accepted as an exception.

notes.value: ADF employees who are trainees on short-term employment (including under a 6-month employment period) are acceptable and treated as standard PAYG — for consumer loans only.

The Broker Guide does not publish default, judgment, bankruptcy, arrears or credit-score thresholds. It does state the Bank will not lend for payment of bad debts (any overdue loan), for debt consolidation where the member applied for consolidation within the preceding 12 months, or for paying court orders, actions or judgements (except to meet Family Court separation or divorce rulings).

constructionAvailable.note: Construction by a licensed builder only, under a fixed price building contract. Fixed rates are not available on construction loans until construction is complete.

genuineSavingsMinMonths.note: 'When genuine savings are required, it needs to be held in the borrower's name for 3 months or more' — acceptable forms are savings account, term deposit, shares, First Home Super Saver Scheme, and a rental ledger (with mitigating broker notes).

rentalLedgerAsGenuineSavings.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Genuine savings and gifted funds, p24
rentalLedgerAsGenuineSavings.note: 'Rental Ledger (with mitigating notes by broker within suitability assessment is required)'.

giftedDepositAccepted.note: From an immediate family member only.

giftedDepositConditions.value: Gifts must be non-repayable, from an immediate family member, held in an account in the name of at least one borrower at the time of formal approval, and accompanied by a statutory declaration from the giver clearly stating the gift does not have to be repaid. Gifts received from a non-immediate family member are not acceptable. Inheritance gifts are acceptable.
giftedDepositConditions.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — Genuine savings and gifted funds, p24

guarantorAccepted.note: Security guarantee ('family pledge') only, not a financial guarantee.

guarantorConditions.value: Guarantor must be immediate family (spouse, de facto, child, parent, grandparent, aunt, uncle, cousin, grandchild or sibling of the applicant or their partner, including step and adoptive relations). Owner occupied or investment purpose only. Repayments must be P&I (IO permitted during construction for a maximum of 2 years). The amount guaranteed must be no more than needed to reduce the new purchase LVR to 80%, and no more than 50% of the guarantor's security value. One family guarantee per loan. Guarantors must obtain independent legal advice. Not available for vacant land purchase (non-construction), home improvements, debt consolidation, refinance, equity release or owner-builder.

notes.value: MEMBERSHIP AND DEFENCE AFFILIATION ARE THE HEADLINE FILTER. The Broker Guide's 'Acceptable Borrowers' section states the Bank lends to individuals who are 'Members of the Bank', 'Australian citizens or permanent residents', 'Employed', and 'Self-employed — Must be Defence bonded'. Applicants must be at least 18 (or 17 if a serving ADF member, capped at a $10,000 loan for education or tools of trade). The Bank describes itself as serving those 'currently serving, ... a Veteran, or a valued part of the Australian Defence Force (ADF) community'.
notes.sourceTitle: Broker Guide — About us (p3), Acceptable Borrowers (p5), Employment (p6)
notes.note: The precise constitutional membership eligibility test is not reproduced in the Broker Guide — see gaps.

gaps: MEMBERSHIP: the Broker Guide requires borrowers to be 'Members of the Bank' but does not reproduce the constitutional eligibility test for membership. AMB positions itself as serving serving/ex-serving ADF members, veterans and the wider Defence community — treat Defence affiliation as the practical filter and confirm with the Bank for non-Defence applicants.

SELF-EMPLOYED HARD FILTER: self-employed borrowers are only considered where the business is ADF/DOD-affiliated, the borrower is the spouse of an ADF/DOD employee who is also a party to the loan, or the borrower is ex-Defence.
No assessment-rate floor is published — only the +3% buffer.
No numeric DTI cap is published; DTI is described as built into auto-decisioning and delegated approval limits.
No credit-history thresholds published (defaults, judgments, bankruptcy, arrears, credit score, enquiries).
Maximum loan amount, maximum loan term and maximum applicant age at maturity are not stated in the Broker Guide.
The restricted/single-industry postcode list itself is not published in the guide (it follows the LMI provider's list).
Temporary-visa and non-resident policy is not addressed.
SMSF and bridging lending are not addressed in the Broker Guide.
Broker submissions are made via aggregator software; the Broker Portal itself is behind a login and was not used.
